name: GP Anchor Packaging Plant - Jonesboro AR

fieldNotes.facility: Anchor Packaging thermoformed-packaging manufacturing plant at 4708 Krueger Drive, Jonesboro AR — acquired by Georgia-Pacific in Oct 2025 (net-new yard ops). Roster coordinate (35.891617, -90.658333) was ~9 km NW in farmland; relocated via web research (4708 Krueger Drive, GPS 35.8135/-90.6392) and confirmed by the 'Anchor Packaging - NOW HIRING' sign with the Anchor logo and the blue Anchor plant sign, both visible in Jan-2026 Street View.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck entrance. The truck driveway enters directly off Krueger Drive as an open driveway — no barrier arm, no sliding/swing gate, no perimeter gate, no guard booth. The plant frontage (employee parking, office) is openly accessible from the public road. Typical light-industrial converting plant in the Jonesboro Industrial Park. truckGate false, guardShack false, remoteGs false.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Short open approach from Krueger Drive to the dock apron — holds only 1-2 trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Loading docks along the W/NW face of the building; a trailer (XPRESS) seen backed in at a dock in Street View. ~18 doors estimated from overhead imagery — low confidence band 10-25.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Paved apron/yard on the west side; small number of trailers — no dedicated separate trailer drop lot. dropArea 0-10, dropYard false.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the SW edge of the area but no spur reaches the Anchor plant — truck-served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural — the plant sits in the Jonesboro Industrial Park on the edge of town near the municipal airport, surrounded by farm fields and scattered industrial buildings.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale imaged — not expected for a thermoformed-packaging converting plant.
